source_event.text: I have four years of office-administration experience, including coordinating meetings and giving short process briefings, but no LMS experience. Northstar's recruiter says strong performers may advance in about 18 to 30 months; its posting lists nominal 9:00-to-5:30 hours, with 7:00 starts or 7:30 finishes during launches. Alder Finch posts regular 8:30-to-5 weekday hours, and its recruiter reports about four quarter-end overtime evenings yearly. With rapid advancement first, followed by people-focused work and transferable skills, which role fits me better?

source_event.text: Actually, stable hours matter more to me now than rapid advancement.
